subject: Re: Follow-up: Critical scan findings — remediation evidence and closure
messages:
From: Acme Security <sec-ops@acme.com>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-03-01T09:12:00Z
Subject: Critical findings from 2028-02-28 infrastructure scan

Hi Sofia,

Our periodic scanner (VulnScan) flagged three critical issues during the 2028-02-28 network/infra scan affecting your public inference cluster used by Acme integration: CVE-2027-3154, CVE-2028-0142, and CVE-2026-9981. We need remediation evidence (patches applied, test verification, and a short timeline) for our SIG/SOC2 tracker.

Can you provide:
- a signed remediation matrix with dates
- the scanner report (PDF) and any diffs or commits that fixed the issues
- confirmation of when the fixes reached prod and any rollback windows

We are on a 10-business-day evidence window per our agreement — ideally within 48 hours for criticals.

Thanks,
Paul Reynolds
Lead Security Engineer
Acme Corp — SecOps
[attachment: scan-report-20280228.pdf]
From: Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.com>
To: Acme Security <sec-ops@acme.com>, Paul Reynolds <paul.reynolds@acme.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-03-01T10:04:00Z
Subject: Re: Critical findings from 2028-02-28 infrastructure scan

Paul — thanks for the heads up and the attached report. We take these very seriously.

Quick plan: I will own the customer communication and evidence handback. Marcus will assemble the remediation artifacts and Neha will pull the deployment/audit logs. We expect to deliver an initial packet within 24 hours and a final closure package within 72 hours.

Immediate next steps (for transparency):
- Marcus: gather commit diffs, CVSS scoring, and patch references for the three CVEs.
- Neha: export deployment timestamps, canary rollout windows, and audit log slices (UTC).
- Connor: prepare a short remediation matrix CSV mapping CVE -> fix -> PR/commit -> prod timestamp.

SLA note: Redwood's critical CVE promise to paying customers is remediation verification within 5 business days; for enterprise integrations we accelerate to 48–72 hours where possible. We will aim for the tighter window here.

I will follow up with the initial packet by EOD.

Best,
Sofia Ivanova
Senior Manager, Security & Compliance
Redwood Inference
From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.com>, Acme Security <sec-ops@acme.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>, Connor Obrien <connor_obrien@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-03-01T14:23:00Z
Subject: Re: Critical findings — artifacts and interim evidence

Attaching initial artifacts for review. Summary below.

Summary of fixes (high level):
- CVE-2027-3154 (libnet-proto kernel vector): fixed via upstream kernel patch backport and controlled restart of inference service; commit: a1b2c3d. Patch applied to canary pool on 2028-03-01T02:10:00Z, full rollout 2028-03-01T07:45:00Z.
- CVE-2028-0142 (third-party tokenizer lib): PR #742 merged with sanitizer checks and input validation; commit: d4e5f6g. Hotfix deployed to prod at 2028-03-01T11:30:00Z.
- CVE-2026-9981 (container runtime isolate escape): mitigated by runtime upgrade to runc 1.4.8 and additional seccomp profiles; deployment timestamp 2028-03-01T12:05:00Z.

Artifacts attached: scan-report-20280228.pdf, fix-diff-refs.patch, remediation-matrix-ACME.csv.

Notes on verification: unit + smoke tests ran in canary windows (30-min rolling), no service regressions observed. Audit slices and deploy logs will follow as a separate archive.

--
Marcus Lin
Principal SRE, Redwood Inference
[attachment: fix-diff-refs.patch]
[attachment: remediation-matrix-ACME.csv]
From: Paul Reynolds <paul.reynolds@acme.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.com>
Cc: Acme Security <sec-ops@acme.com>
Date: 2028-03-01T18:06:00Z
Subject: Re: Critical findings — artifacts and interim evidence

Marcus / Sofia — thanks for the quick packet. A couple clarifying asks before we mark these closed on our side:

1) Can you confirm CVSS base scores you used for each CVE and the vector strings? Our auditor wants the scores you used (we may have a slightly different calc).
2) We need a redacted segment of the deployment audit showing the exact host IDs and UTC timestamps for the rollouts (we'll accept a ZIP with logs redacted for customer data).
3) For the kernel backport: were any kernel ABI changes required? If so, were dependent packages rebuilt or was it a straight backport?

If you can respond with a short note and the audit-logs ZIP by tomorrow EOD (2028-03-02) we can close this in SIG.

—Paul
From: Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.com>
To: Paul Reynolds <paul.reynolds@acme.com>, Acme Security <sec-ops@acme.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Connor Obrien <connor_obrien@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-03-02T16:45:00Z
Subject: Re: Critical findings — remediation evidence and closure confirmation

Paul — closing the loop with the requested items attached.

What we delivered:
- CVSS base scores and vectors: CVE-2027-3154 = 9.1 (CVSS:3.1/AV:N/AC:L/PR:N/UI:N/S:U/C:H/I:H/A:H)
  CVE-2028-0142 = 8.8 (CVSS:3.1/AV:N/AC:L/PR:N/UI:R/S:U/C:H/I:H/A:N)
  CVE-2026-9981 = 9.8 (CVSS:3.1/AV:N/AC:L/PR:N/UI:N/S:C/C:H/I:H/A:H)

- Deployment audit logs: audit-logs-2028-03-02.zip (redacted host IDs, includes UTC timestamps for canary and full rollouts).
- Remediation matrix CSV linking CVE -> PR/commit -> deploy timestamps (remediation-matrix-ACME.csv).
- Source diffs/patch references: fix-diff-refs.patch.
- Scanner PDF: scan-report-20280228.pdf

Additional answers:
- Kernel backport: a straight backport was applied (no ABI changes required); dependent packages were validated in a test pass but not rebuilt. Details are in the remediation matrix.
- Verification window: canary smoke tests ran for 30 minutes per canary segment; full rollout had a 1-hour monitoring window.

We have uploaded the same packet to the shared folder (link below) and linked JIRA ACME-4921 for traceability. If you need a signed attestation PDF with the SRE lead's signature, let me know and we will produce it.

Closing statement: Redwood confirms the three CVEs listed above were mitigated and verified in production on 2028-03-01 as documented. We will keep the audit artifacts in our SOC2 evidence repository for 12 months per our retention policy.

Sincerely,
Sofia Ivanova
Senior Manager, Security & Compliance
Redwood Inference
[attachment: audit-logs-2028-03-02.zip]
